text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
My mission for the day... is complete.
Now, to
return to my routine...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Kris S. Are you not greater than
the
monistic urge to return to your
source?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I haven't particularly explored other
options.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then listen now to your ego's whispers.
Let your
inner persona crash the facade,
and act upon
your heart's desires.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any strong desires right now.
At
most... I suppose I'm thirsty.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Good, good. Let the tides of élan vital
overwhelm
your conscience. Tell
me—what does your psyche
demand?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Oddly, I'm in the mood for sparkling
water. I'll
head to the vending machine.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The vending machine cannot assuage
your body's
screams for salvation! It
yearns not for fleeting
plastic-entombed
relief, but a more lasting
elysium! Let us
drink in the hall of heroes, dear
einheri!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see now. You mean to say you're also
thirsty.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Mmwahahaha! That is but a trivial detail!
You
needn't philosophize on my every
word! Does the
nectar not flow sweet
regardless?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Are you done? Let's head over, then.
To the
cafeteria.
